description.en: The ID of the image repository.

description.zh:
触发触发器的镜像版本。

> - `TriggerType`为`ALL`，`TriggerTag`可以为任意字符串，示例`*`。
- `TriggerType`为`TAG_LIST`，`TriggerTag`为数组，示例`[1]`。
- `TriggerType`为`TAG_REG_EXP`，`TriggerTag`为字符串，示例`*`。
description.en:
The image tag based on which the trigger is set.

> 

*   If `TriggerType` is set to `ALL`, `TriggerTag` can be set to a string or an array, for example, `*`.

*   If `TriggerType` is set to `TAG_LIST`, `TriggerTag` must be set to an array, for example, `[1]`.
*   If `TriggerType` is set to `TAG_REG_EXP`, `TriggerTag` must be set to a string, for example, `*`.

description.zh:
触发器类型，取值：
- `ALL`：全部触发
- `TAG_LIST`：Tag触发
- `TAG_REG_EXP`：表达式触发
description.en:
The type of the trigger. Valid values:

*   `ALL`: a trigger that supports both tags and regular expressions.
*   `TAG_LIST`: a tag-based trigger.
*   `TAG_REG_EXP`: a regular expression-based trigger.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr create-repo-trigger --instance-id cri-xkx6vujuhay00000 --repo-id crr-xwvi3osiy4ff0000 --trigger-name trigger1 --trigger-url http://www.mysite.com --trigger-type ALL --trigger-tag 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cr CreateRepoTrigger --region cn-hangzhou --TriggerUrl 'http://www.mysite.com' --TriggerType ALL --TriggerName trigger1 --InstanceId 'cri-xkx6vujuhay00000' --TriggerTag 1 --RepoId 'crr-xwvi3osiy4ff0000'
